title: Follow the full join flow and reach discovery
description: This test verifies that a new member can complete onboarding with required identity and skill selections and continue into discovery.

steps.description: Scroll the homepage to the join area
Fill in the name field with a valid display name
Fill in the email field with a valid email address
Verify the discovery page is displayed
Verify the onboarded member experience is available

title: Complete the join flow and reach discovery
description: A new member can enter identity details, choose teach and learn skills, join the network, and land on discovery.

steps.description: Fill in the name field with a valid full name
Fill in the email field with a valid email address
Select one or more skills to teach
Select one or more skills to learn
Verify the discover page is displayed

title: Reveal the homepage story while browsing the constellation
description: This test verifies that a guest can scroll the homepage to reveal the constellation experience and the five-act narrative in sequence.

steps.description: Verify the constellation network is displayed
Verify the story reveals multiple acts in sequence

title: Submit a valid exchange proposal

steps.description: Select what you want to receive
Fill an optional message into the message field
Verify the new proposed trade appears

title: Prevent joining with missing identity details

steps.description: Verify the form remains on the identity step
Verify validation errors for the required identity fields are visible

Verify the profile list updates to match the current criteria
Verify filtered profile cards are displayed

steps.description: Verify a proposed trade is visible

steps.description: Verify the trade is no longer shown as proposed
Verify the accepted trade is displayed

title: Open a profile from discovery
description: This test verifies that clicking a profile card in discovery opens the selected person's profile page.

description: A visitor can open a profile and review the person’s bio, skills, trust, hours, and recent trades.

Hover over a node in the constellation
Verify a profile name is displayed for the hovered node

Verify each proposal shows available actions

Verify the accepted trade is visible in the accepted trades tab

description: This test verifies that a member can mark an accepted trade complete and then see it in the completed inbox tab.
